mapper.sql: a.id, a.version, a.name, a.number, a.feature_id, b.feature_key, COALESCE(b.custom_name, b.default_name) AS feature_name, COALESCE(b.app_id, a.app_id) AS app_id, c.name AS app_name
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.name, a.number, a.feature_id, b.feature_key, COALESCE(b.custom_name, b.default_name) AS feature_name, COALESCE(b.app_id, a.app_id) AS app_id, c.name AS app_name FROM t_sys_permission a LEFT JOIN t_sys_feature b ON b.id = a.feature_id INNER JOIN t_sys_app c ON c.id = COALESCE(b.app_id, a.app_id)
COALESCE(b.app_id, a.app_id) = #{form.appId} c.cloud_id = #{form.cloudId} AND a.feature_id = #{form.featureId}
AND (a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%') OR a.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY a.number, a.id

SELECT FROM t_sys_permission a LEFT JOIN t_sys_feature b ON b.id = a.feature_id INNER JOIN t_sys_app c ON c.id = COALESCE(b.app_id, a.app_id) ORDER BY COALESCE(b.app_id, a.app_id), COALESCE(b.custom_seq, b.default_seq), a.number

SELECT FROM t_sys_permission a LEFT JOIN t_sys_feature b ON b.id = a.feature_id INNER JOIN t_sys_app c ON c.id = COALESCE(b.app_id, a.app_id)
COALESCE(b.app_id, a.app_id) = #{form.appId} AND a.feature_id = #{form.featureId} AND a.feature_id IS NULL
AND (a.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%') OR a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY a.number

SELECT , a.create_time, a.update_time, a.create_user, a.update_user FROM t_sys_permission a LEFT JOIN t_sys_feature b ON b.id = a.feature_id INNER JOIN t_sys_app c ON c.id = COALESCE(b.app_id, a.app_id) WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT a.number FROM t_sys_permission a INNER JOIN t_sys_role_perms b ON b.permission_id = a.id INNER JOIN t_sys_user_role c ON c.role_id = b.role_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.org_id = #{orgId}
AND a.number LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
